name: regain
description: Opens a project's .regain pages with runnable Python and shell blocks and project-reviewed line explanations.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Let Codex or Claude Code trace the project, then explore its capability map and analyzed source walkthroughs.
[Prepare current project](command:regain.initCurrent)
[Choose a project folder](command:regain.initFolder)
[Create an empty folder](command:regain.createFolder)

regain.claudeExecutable.description: Claude Code CLI executable. Set an absolute path if claude is not on PATH.

regain.python.description: Python used for the kernel. Empty: the interpreter selected in the Python extension, else python3. It needs jupyter_client and ipykernel.

regain.claudeModel.description: Model for Claude Code analysis: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id. Empty: Claude Code's own default.

regain.claudeFastModel.description: Model for classifying repository files with Claude Code, the bulk step. Empty: use ReGain: Claude Model.

regain.codexModel.description: Model for Codex analysis. Empty: the model in your Codex configuration.

scripts.test: node test/format.test.js && node test/diff.test.js && node test/view.test.js && node test/provider.test.js && node test/parallel.test.js && node test/diagram.test.js && node test/map-flow.test.js && node test/agent.test.js && node test/guide-view.test.js && node test/kernel.test.js
